subtopic: Limits at Infinity and Infinite Limits
Limits at Infinity and Infinite Limits
solution:
\(\lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\frac{10x^2+5x+3}{5x^2-3x+8}\right]\)

Divide by \(x^2\) to get finite limits of the numerator as well as of the denominator.

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{\dfrac{10x^2+5x+3}{x^2}}{\dfrac{5x^2-3x+8}{x^2}}\right]\)

\(= \dfrac{\lim_{x \to \infty}\left[10 + \dfrac{5}{x} + \dfrac{3}{x^2}\right]}{\lim_{x \to \infty}\left[5 - \dfrac{3}{x} + \dfrac{8}{x^2}\right]}\)

\(= \dfrac{10+0+0}{5-0+0}\)   \(\left(\because \lim_{x \to \infty}\dfrac{1}{x} = 0\right)\)

\(= \dfrac{10}{5}\)

\(= 2\)

subtopic: Limits at Infinity and Infinite Limits
solution:
\(\lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\sqrt{x^2+3x} - x\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{(\sqrt{x^2+3x} - x)(\sqrt{x^2+3x} + x)}{(\sqrt{x^2+3x} + x)}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{x^2+3x-x^2}{\sqrt{x^2+3x} + x}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{3x}{\sqrt{x^2+3x} + x}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{3x}{x\sqrt{1 + \dfrac{3}{x}} + x}\right]\)

\(= \lim_{x \to \infty}\left[\dfrac{3}{\sqrt{1 + \dfrac{3}{x}} + 1}\right]\)

\(= \dfrac{3}{\sqrt{1+0} + 1}\)   \(\left(\because \lim_{x \to \infty}\dfrac{1}{x} = 0\right)\)

\(= \dfrac{3}{1+1}\)

\(= \dfrac{3}{2}\)
